boards.title: Reject with a reason

gaps.element: Spec copy 'AO3 emails your reason to kestrelmoon. It cannot be edited afterwards…' and a required Reason field
gaps.current: The sheet says this verbatim, but the reason is validated and then thrown away. AO3's item form has no reason field (AO3CollectionActions.swift:119-128 posts only moderatorApproval=.rejected), so the creator never gets the text the moderator was told AO3 would email
gaps.needs: OWNER DECISION: rewrite the copy to say AO3 sends no reason (and offer to post it as a comment on the work), or drop the required reason. The current UI promises an email that never happens

gaps.element: Spec 'the sheet cannot be dismissed empty' (the reason is protected until sent or cancelled)
gaps.current: No .interactiveDismissDisabled. A swipe-down discards a typed reason silently; only the buttons are guarded

boards.notes: Visually faithful: title, copy, Reason panel with SubjectFieldLabel, 'Required' and 'n / 1000' counter, Cancel and a filled 'Reject and send' button disabled until valid, and a failed reject leaves the item queued (performReject L164 only removes on success). The major gap is truthfulness, not layout. ModeratedItemsView.swift:250 repeats the same false email claim.

areaNotes: All six board ids printed; 1bx has two screens (Maintainers | Moderated items), reported as 1bx and 1bx#1. Cross-cutting: (1) 1ce and ModeratedItemsView tell moderators AO3 will email their reject reason, but AO3CollectionActions.rejectCollectionItem (AO3CollectionActions.swift:119-128) discards it because AO3's item form has no reason field. That needs an owner copy decision before release. (2) ModeratedItemsView is dead code, never instantiated. (3) 1cg reuses the 1bl form layout rather than 1cg's section structure. (4) Several 'data not available' code comments are stale: AO3CollectionItem.itemDateText exists but 1cd and 1bx#1 don't show it, and challenge reveal dates are parsed (AO3ChallengeSettings) but 1cd/1cg don't read them. (5) Counts across 1cd, 1ci and 1bx#1 are page-1 row counts, not totals. AO3 writes in this area (approve, reject, accept, decline, reveal, un-anon, invite, step down, settings save, tag-set save, nomination reject) are built and have never been live-exercised. No owner-decision comments were found for any board in this area.
